title: Standard us spelling
statement: Each cell of a $3 \times 3$ grid is colored red or blue. In how many colorings does every row contain at least one blue cell and every column contain at least one red cell?
hints: Count the complement with inclusion and exclusion.
Choose which rows are all red and which columns are all blue.
solution: A column that is all blue already gives every row a blue cell. So the colourings with no all-red row number $(2^3 - 1)^3 = 343$, and we must remove those with some all-blue column. Colourings with no all-blue column also number $343$ by symmetry, so $512 - 343 = 169$ colourings have an all-blue column, and every one of them has no all-red row. The answer is $343 - 169 = 174$.
check_program:
from itertools import product
c = 0
for g in product([0, 1], repeat=9):
    rows = [g[0:3], g[3:6], g[6:9]]
    if all(1 in r for r in rows) and all(any(r[i] == 0 for r in rows) for i in range(3)):
        c += 1
print(c)
